data.name: Araiqah
data.gender_notes: Araiqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'rahqa', meaning 'to guide'. This name is given to a girl who is believed to be guided by Allah. The name Araiqah carries the meaning “The One Who is Guided” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Araiqah usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who is guided and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A sign of Allah's guidance in one's life.
data.etymology: Araiqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who is Guided.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Araiqah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
